command:
set -eo pipefail
cd /tmp
printf '%s  %s\n' 6949939b5937046f1ec7fdcc764dc47df5dd3c35d48b5487470ae3527d21b04a HG00096.chr20_2.0-2.4Mb.30x.bam > b.sha256
sha256sum -c b.sha256
echo "== HaplotypeCaller (reference + its staged .fai/.dict already present) =="
gatk HaplotypeCaller -R chr20.fa -I HG00096.chr20_2.0-2.4Mb.30x.bam -L chr20:2000000-2400000 --native-pair-hmm-threads 1 -O gatk.vcf.gz > hc.log 2>&1
zcat gatk.vcf.gz > gatk.vcf
TOTAL=$(grep -vc '^#' gatk.vcf || true)
SNV=$(awk '!/^#/ && length($4)==1 && length($5)==1' gatk.vcf | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
NONCHR20=$(awk '!/^#/ && $1!="chr20"' gatk.vcf | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
SAMPLE=$(awk '/^#CHROM/{print NF-9; exit}' gatk.vcf)
GKL=$(grep -c 'LOGLESS_CACHING' hc.log || true)
{
  echo "variants_total     $TOTAL  want 700..900  (observed 802)"
  echo "snv_count          $SNV  want 560..760  (observed 661)"
  echo "all_on_chr20       $NONCHR20  want 0"
  echo "sample_column      $SAMPLE  want 1"
  echo "arm64_java_pairhmm $GKL  want >=1 (Intel GKL AVX .so cannot load on AArch64 -> LOGLESS_CACHING)"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt
test "$TOTAL" -ge 700; test "$TOTAL" -le 900
test "$SNV" -ge 560; test "$SNV" -le 760
test "$NONCHR20" -eq 0; test "$SAMPLE" -eq 1; test "$GKL" -ge 1
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
